# Du7 Technology Services

> Independent engineering business (Netherlands, KVK 91476003) doing pragmatic
> infrastructure, cloud, and IoT work — from Raspberry Pi to AWS. Contact:
> info@du7.dev. This site is a temporary landing page; the projects below are
> the best representation of the work.

## Projects

- [rittenregistratie-bot](https://github.com/eduelias/rittenregistratie-bot):
  Self-hosted WhatsApp bot keeping a Belastingdienst-compliant car trip log
  (Dutch "rittenregistratie"). Python 3.11+, runs on a Raspberry Pi, writes
  audit-ready per-year Excel files, plugin system for odometer/trajectory
  sources. MIT licensed.
- [nucleus-job-plugin](https://github.com/eduelias/nucleus-job-plugin):
  Unofficial Rust runner for AWS IoT Jobs on Greengrass v2 devices. Executes
  allow-listed job handlers and reports status, reaching IoT Core through the
  Greengrass nucleus's own MQTT connection. Ships as a generic Greengrass
  component. Not affiliated with Amazon.
- [greengrass-ipc](https://github.com/eduelias/greengrass-ipc): Pure-Rust
  async client for AWS IoT Greengrass v2 component IPC (Unix-domain-socket
  eventstream). No C/FFI; tokio-based; implements operations the official
  bindings lack. On crates.io as `greengrass-ipc`. Not affiliated with Amazon.
